title: Impact of Military Artificial Intelligence on Nuclear Escalation Risk

items.verbatim_quote: This raises the fundamental question of whether AI introduces new risks, exacerbates existing ones or fundamentally alters the nature of nuclear escalation.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者提出一个根本性问题：人工智能是引入了新的风险，加剧了现有风险，还是从根本上改变了核升级的性质。

items.verbatim_quote: Section III concludes by summarizing the findings and indicating a potential direction for future policy-oriented research aimed at addressing this risk through existing or novel risk-reduction measures.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，未来政策导向的研究方向是通过现有或新的风险降低措施来应对这一风险。

items.verbatim_quote: This paper initiates a deeper exploration of this fundamental question.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认本文只是对这一根本问题的初步探索，暗示研究尚不完整。

items.verbatim_quote: Assessing the effect of military AI on nuclear escalation risk is highly complex due to the potential for AI to be integrated in various systems and at various levels across the military domain. This complexity is compounded by the variety of drivers of nuclear escalation, sources of nuclear risk and the fragile balance of strategic stability.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者承认，评估军事人工智能对核升级风险的影响非常复杂，因为人工智能可能以多种方式集成到不同军事系统和层级中，且核升级的驱动因素、风险来源和战略稳定性脆弱平衡进一步加剧了这种复杂性。

items.verbatim_quote: the lack of transparency in this system prevents understanding of why it selected the most escalatory options.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，由于AI系统缺乏透明度，无法理解其为何选择最升级的选项，这构成了当前研究的一个局限。

items.verbatim_quote: Developing measures to mitigate the risk of nuclear use requires further examination of how military applications of AI can influence nuclear escalation risk in particular contexts and specific crisis scenarios.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者建议未来研究需要进一步考察军事人工智能应用在特定情境和具体危机场景中如何影响核升级风险，以制定风险缓解措施。

items.verbatim_quote: Elaborating on scenarios in which AI influences nuclear escalation can help inform the adaptation of existing risk-reduction measures or the development of new ones at the AI–nuclear nexus.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者建议未来研究应详细阐述人工智能影响核升级的场景，以帮助调整现有风险降低措施或开发新的措施。

items.verbatim_quote: These scenarios, for example, could highlight potential approaches to developing training standards for users of military AI. In turn, these approaches could establish redundancies that enable cross-checking of information from multiple sources and systems in order to prevent the deferral of responsibility to AI and ensure that operators are able to critically assess and challenge AI-generated recommendations.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者建议未来研究可通过场景分析，探索制定军事人工智能用户培训标准的方法，建立冗余机制以交叉核对多源信息，防止责任推卸给AI，并确保操作员能够批判性评估和质疑AI建议。

items.verbatim_quote: a 2024 study on fictional nuclear escalation scenarios found that large language models (LLMs)—a type of AI—often chose more escalatory options than human participants. This might be due to bias in training data or to the fact that AI lacks human empathy and may more readily make critical escalatory decisions as it is not subject to moral consideration or social norms, such as the nuclear use taboo. However, the lack of transparency in this system prevents understanding of why it selected the most escalatory options.
items.author_claim_cn: 作者批评一项2024年的研究，指出其发现LLM在虚构核升级场景中比人类更倾向于选择升级选项，但该研究未能解释原因，因为AI系统缺乏透明度，无法理解其决策逻辑。
items.target_of_critique: Rivera, J.-P. et al., 'Escalation risks from language models in military and diplomatic decision-making', FAccT '24, 2024.

raw_item.verbatim_quote: the ways in which military AI can influence the risk of nuclear escalation—even AI that is not directly integrated into nuclear systems—remain relatively underexplored.
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者指出，军事人工智能影响核升级风险的方式——即使是未直接整合到核系统中的人工智能——仍然相对未被充分探索。

raw_item.verbatim_quote: Scenarios could also contribute to the development of additional transparency and confidence-building measures such as military hotlines and notification regimes that can help mitigate nuclear risk stemming from both AI-driven decision-support systems and the integration of AI in conventional systems with counterforce potential.
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者建议未来研究可通过场景分析促进额外的透明度和建立信任措施，如军事热线和通报机制，以减轻由AI驱动的决策支持系统和AI集成到具有反力量潜力的常规系统所带来的核风险。

raw_item.verbatim_quote: AI is good at solving puzzles (i.e. making sense of data and collating it in a way that makes sense for humans), but not so good at resolving mysteries (e.g. predicting intentions or national resolve).
raw_item.author_claim_cn: 作者批评现有AI能力，指出AI擅长解决“谜题”（如数据处理），但不擅长解决“奥秘”（如预测意图或国家决心），这限制了其在核升级风险中的应用。
raw_item.target_of_critique: Goldfarb, A. and Lindsay, J. R., 'Prediction and judgement: Why artificial intelligence increases the importance of humans in war', International Security, vol. 46, no. 3 (winter 2021/22).
